description: This file defines the AuthorRepository interface extending JpaRepository, providing database operations for the Author entity, including custom methods with entity graph annotations for eager fetching of associated books.

classes.name: AuthorRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for performing CRUD operations on Author entities with specific entity graph for optimized fetching.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds an Author by ID with books eagerly fetched via EntityGraph.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all authors with books eagerly fetched.
